A [[Unidentified pirate group (Sayblohn)|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] operated from a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sayblohn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was raided<ref name="RPG" /> by [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|406|Okfili}}</ref> after the pirate's [[Unidentified pirate leader (Sayblohn)|leader]] [[Death/Legends|murdered]] an [[Unidentified Alliance contact|Alliance contact]] and stole an art object of religious significance to the [[Okfili]].<ref name="RPG" />
